thread:
faiza: Quick note: proposing a "low-noise cutover" for multi-region active/active rollouts to avoid p95 spikes and accidental cross-region data moves.
ben: Agreed. Minimal state machine: PREWARM -> RAMP -> STABILIZE -> COMMIT/ROLLBACK.
harry: Runtime concerns: cold KV -> big cost, model warmup, and tokenizer mismatches. Prefetch top-50 keys + warm small synthetic prompts. Also mark incompatible model variants in catalog.
legal: Residency rule: tenants with `residency:strict` must be hard-blocked from cross-region. For `residency:soft` allow `grace_seconds` with audit. Audit payload must include tenant_id, operator, timestamp, and reason; EU tenant audits stored in EU.
faiza: Rollback triggers: p95 > sla + 40ms for 2m OR 5xx_rate > 2x baseline OR remote_kv_miss > 3x. Operator can override timings per-rollout.
infra-bot: Canary started: low-noise-cutover-v1 -> eu-slice-A -> bias=10% -> prewarm running.
ben: I'll draft RFC with config schema and router pseudocode. harry: I'll prototype prefetch script with cost guard. legal: will provide audit field schema.
faiza: Target RFC by end of week. If telemetry trips, infra-bot please run rollback and page oncall.
